name: envp
install: [ -x /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix ] || curl -fsSL https://install.determinate.systems/nix | sh -s -- install linux --init none --no-confirm && /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix profile add "github:NixOS/nixpkgs/$(/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix eval --raw --impure --expr '(builtins.fromJSON (builtins.readFile ./flake.lock)).nodes.nixpkgs.locked.rev')#devenv" && ~/.nix-profile/bin/devenv shell -- true
